description: This file defines a PreferencesRepository class that manages user preferences related to SSH configuration, app package selection, execution flags, and timestamps, utilizing Android's DataStore Preferences with reactive Flows and suspend functions for atomic updates.

classes.name: PreferencesRepository
classes.description: Provides an interface for storing and retrieving user preferences related to SSH configuration, selected applications, flags, and timestamps using Android DataStore.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of PreferencesRepository, initializing it with application context if necessary.

methods.name: setSshHost
methods.description: Updates the SSH host in preferences after validation.

methods.name: setSshPort
methods.description: Updates the SSH port in preferences after validation.

methods.name: setSshUsername
methods.description: Updates the SSH username in preferences after validation.

methods.name: setSshCommandTemplate
methods.description: Sets the SSH command template string in preferences.

methods.name: setSshConfig
methods.description: Updates all SSH configuration parameters atomically after validation.

methods.name: setSelectedPackages
methods.description: Replaces the entire set of selected package names in preferences.

methods.name: addSelectedPackage
methods.description: Adds a single package name to the set of selected packages.

methods.name: removeSelectedPackage
methods.description: Removes a specific package name from the set of selected packages.

methods.name: setRunOnlyWhenUnlocked
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating whether to run only when device is unlocked.

methods.name: isValidHost
methods.description: Checks if a host string is valid (non-empty after trimming).

methods.name: isValidPort
methods.description: Checks if a port number is within the valid TCP port range.

methods.name: isValidUsername
methods.description: Checks if a username string is valid (non-empty after trimming).
